edits.old: Then the review stays "OPEN" while an item is open and the two accepted requests keep their reference
edits.new:
Then the review stays "OPEN" while an item is open and the two accepted requests keep their reference

  Scenario: AC6 The interval is configuration, a reason code outside the contract is refused, and a break-glass grant adds MSG-P4-004 (new, D-RCV-60)
    Given the access-review Schedule interval is set in its deployment configuration to the DL38 placeholder value of six months
    When the interval is changed in the Schedule configuration only
    Then the review cycle follows the changed interval and no code is changed
    When a decision posts a reason code outside the contract enumeration
    Then the response is refused and no decision is stored
    Given a break-glass grant is active for "U-4101"
    When "U-4101" calls GET /api/recovery/access/v1/admin/access-reviews/AR-2027-H1
    Then the answer carries MSG-P4-004 and each decision-record entry carries the grant id

  Scenario: AC7 A call without a valid token is answered 401 and an unknown review is answered 404 (new, D-RCV-60)
    Given a caller presents no valid token
    When the caller calls GET /api/recovery/access/v1/admin/access-reviews/AR-2027-H1
    Then the response is 401 and no role and no holder is answered
    Given a review id that does not exist
    When "U-4101" calls GET /api/recovery/access/v1/admin/access-reviews/{reviewId}
    Then the response is 404 and no role and no holder is answered

  Scenario: AC8 A removal request activity that times out is retried and opens no second cycle (new, D-RCV-60)
    Given review "AR-2027-H2" is closed with one holder still "PENDING" and its removal request activity times out
    When the workflow retries the removal request activity
    Then one removal request is accepted for that holder and the item moves to "REMOVAL_REQUESTED"
    Then the retry opens no second review and writes one decision-record entry per removal request

  Scenario: AC9 The bank IAM does not answer a removal request and the item stays open (new, D-RCV-60)
    Given the bank IAM contract mock does not answer for holder "U-4105" in review "AR-2027-H2"
    When the review closes
    Then the item stays "PENDING" with the failure reason, a follow-up task is raised to the role owner and the security administrator, and an incident is recorded
    Then the review stays "OPEN" while the item is open
